I4.quote: activated carbon with BET surface area of >1900 m2 g−1 (purchased from Fuzhou Yihuan Carbon Co. Ltd.)

I5.quote: In recent years, large fluctuations have been reported for measurements of the hydrogen storage of carbon materials using a Sieverts apparatus.

notes: Volumetric (Sieverts) H2 uptake measured on MWCNTs, AC, SWCNTs, GNFs and GO at 295 K/ambient and 77 K up to 7.5 MPa (Figs. 3, 4, 9-12), corrected for sample-cell physisorption. I4 rests on a single supplier-type value for the purchased AC, stated as a lower bound (>1900 m2/g, BET); the AC's H2 uptake is measured (Figs. 9 and 11, 0.375 g AC at 77 K). No other surface area is reported for any sample. The value is specific to the product used, not a typical value for a kind of material, so I4 is judged met; a second assessor could treat a bound-only value differently. No supplementary files were provided; no retraction or prior-publication statement found.
